message_body.subject: Quick question on multi-agent loop termination & deadlock defense
message_body.body:
Hi Team,

Noticed the common challenge in production multi-agent pipelines where agents enter recursive loops during tool delegation or hit recursion limits when subagents deadlock.

We built a 15-Point Black-Box Multi-Agent Safety Audit (€99, 24h SLA) that detects loop runaway risks, deadlock states, and stale lock collisions.

Key feature: Zero-Access Security. You don't need to share any repo access, private prompts, or API keys—we analyze only sanitized error schemas or execution traces. Includes 3 concrete drop-in Python mitigation recipes (generation-fenced locks, monotonic timeouts, bounded retries).

Would you be open to a 24-hour audit of one agent workflow for €99 fixed? If so, reply 'AUDIT' and we'll send the 1-page intake checklist.

Best regards,
